title: A conservative micro-continuum-cellular automaton method for multispecies biofilm dynamics in complex flows
summary: We develop a conservative micro-continuum-cellular automaton method for simulating multispecies biofilm dynamics in complex flows. The proposed method couples the Darcy-Brinkman-Stokes equations, reactive transport, suspended bacteria, and biofilm dynamics with a two-stage cellular automaton algorithm for biofilm redistribution and interface evolution. While treating biofilms as evolving porous media, we ensure conservative redistribution of multispecies biomass across partially occupied cells.
